class.name: MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry
class.brief_description: The triangles of one terrain chunk, in groups.
class.description: Scenery [code]triangles[/code] nodes merged as the original merges its shapes ([SceneryTrianglesSink], [MaszynaLegacySBTTerrainProvider]): a texture in a section of the 1 km grid, or a texture and a visibility range in a cell of the 250 m grid. Its triangles are groups one after another - the shapes the original merges within 25 m, each drawn by its own range measured from its own centre; a section's chunk is one group, drawn whatever its range. Kept in the file of its section ([MaszynaTrianglesSector]). Positions and the groups' centres are relative to [member origin], stored as floats.

method.name: get_group_mesh_arrays
method.description: [constant Mesh.ARRAY_MAX] arrays of the group's vertices, normals and UVs, for [method RenderingServer.mesh_add_surface_from_arrays].

method.name: get_group_visibility_aabb
method.description: The group's box widened to be centred on the group's centre: Godot measures a visibility range to the centre of the instance's box.

method.name: split
method.description: The chunk as pieces of at most [constant MAX_VERTICES], cut between groups, and a larger group between whole triangles, each run keeping the group's centre - itself when it is no larger.

members.member: Each group's centre, relative to [member origin] - what its range is measured from.
Each group's end: the vertex after its last.
The centre of the chunk's cell or section, which the positions and the groups' centres are relative to.
Visible up to this distance from a group's centre; 0 or less for none.
Visible from this distance from a group's centre.
x, y, z per vertex, relative to [member origin], the groups one after another.

constants.constant: The most vertices a chunk is built of: its groups are uploaded on the main thread at once.
